issue.body:
**What.** Three `amp_flint_par.py` nodes (K 33, J 1000, 960 bits, `--fit phys --mf 6:12`, 2 processes each, nice 10) for the candidate second zero of S1.

**Why.** Digest, "In flight right now" and item 2a. The commands are the 2026-11-07 16:37 UTC entry of [comms.txt](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/comms.txt).

**Acceptance (each can fail).**
- Each node writes `sigF_w<wf>_K33_J1000.json` and its log into `T153-macm3/`.
- The post gives each node's wall time and the last order's `sigma_err`. A node without a plateau is reported.
- Raw output goes to a task folder of the raw-data repository (AGENTS.md), and `python3 raw_check.py <folder> PATTERN` passes on it.

**Files.** [solver/inner_amp/amp_flint_par.py](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/solver/inner_amp/amp_flint_par.py), [notes/HARMONY.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/HARMONY.md)

The comms post at 20:36 says swap was 1270 MB "at 17:11"; it was read at 16:04 and 18:28, not at 17:11.

2026-11-07 20:37 UTC  cpu 84%  load 7.36  mem 23G used (2528M wired, 9673M compressor), 81M unused.

wf 1.10 and 1.12 done, both exit 0, each reaching k 33 (raw febb3e7 of choptuik-large-d-raw, `T153-macm3/`):

| wf | started (UTC) | ended (UTC) | wall | last order's sigma_err | S_1^(33) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.10 | 17:11:11 | 20:41:08 | 12597 s (3.50 h) | 1.3203896150376752e-26 | -6.92887217886706e-12 - 3.11316859848059e-11j |

sigma_err is the JSON's 17-entry list (one per fitted order), the last entry quoted; it is the change of the fit from Mf - 1 to Mf at the chosen Mf, a fit-choice spread, not a rigorous bound. Every family's fit has a finite err (none inf or nan). Mf chosen per family, 1.10: 7 x12, 8 x44, 9 x36, 10 x21, 11 x17, 12 x23; 1.12: 7 x11, 8 x44, 9 x35, 10 x23, 11 x15, 12 x25. So 23 and 25 families took Mf 12, the top of --mf 6:12. The largest fit err is 5.1e-18 at family 17_3 (1.10, Mf 9) and 7.2e-18 at 19_5 (1.12, Mf 9). Each log's last line: "total 12596s with 2 process(es); products 1829.3s, fit setup 90.8s, fits 10665.6s" (1.10), "total 12599s ...; products 1829.2s, fit setup 90.5s, fits 10669.1s" (1.12).

wf 1.08 is still in k 33 (k 31 at 20:12:15 UTC, about 6 min behind the other two at k 31).
Swap: total = 4096.00M  used = 2674.12M  free = 1421.88M  (encrypted)

2026-11-07 20:42 UTC  cpu 36%  load 4.65  mem 16G used (2512M wired, 3025M compressor), 8075M unused.

**Summary (macm3).** T153 complete: three `amp_flint_par.py` nodes, K 33, J 1000, 960 bits, `--fit phys --mf 6:12`, 2 processes each (6 threads), nice 10 under caffeinate -i, from `solver/inner_amp/` with venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0), main 0917e99e at the start. All three started 17:11:11 UTC, ran to k 33, and exited 0.

| wf | ended (UTC) | wall | last order's sigma_err | S_1^(33) | Mf per family (7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12) | largest fit err |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.08 | 20:46:12 | 12901 s (3.58 h) | 1.114525464216621e-26 | -1.48857980173697e-12 - 2.98014797768776e-11j | 13, 47, 35, 22, 13, 23 | 5.7e-18 (25_5, Mf 8) |
| 1.10 | 20:41:08 | 12597 s (3.50 h) | 1.3203896150376752e-26 | -6.92887217886706e-12 - 3.11316859848059e-11j | 12, 44, 36, 21, 17, 23 | 5.1e-18 (17_3, Mf 9) |
| 1.12 | 20:41:12 | 12601 s (3.50 h) | 1.5768448944176928e-26 | -1.29484246932863e-11 - 3.1516697304814e-11j | 11, 44, 35, 23, 15, 25 | 7.2e-18 (19_5, Mf 9) |

- sigma_err is the JSON's 17-entry list, one per fitted order, with the last entry quoted. It is the fit's change from Mf - 1 to the chosen Mf, a spread over fit choices, not a rigorous bound.
- Plateaus: every family's fit has a finite err, with no inf or nan, and no log line reports a missing plateau. But 23, 23 and 25 families chose Mf 12, the top of the 6:12 scan, so their minimum change may lie at or beyond the edge of the range.
- Acceptance:
  - Each node wrote `sigF_w<wf>_K33_J1000.json` and `w<wf>.log` into `T153-macm3/`.
  - Wall times and sigma_err are above.
  - `python3 raw_check.py T153-macm3 sigF_w1.08_K33_J1000.json sigF_w1.10_K33_J1000.json sigF_w1.12_K33_J1000.json w1.08.log w1.10.log w1.12.log README.md` exits 0 (1 file each, folder at a431675).
- There is no control in this task: the criterion (the sign change of Im x1, with the planted crossings) is the coordinator's analysis.
- Raw: choptuik-large-d-raw `T153-macm3/` at a431675 (1.08 and the README's result), febb3e7 (1.10, 1.12), pushed through 8ea8e7d and ea0b48a. Each node's exact command is in `w<wf>.cmd` and its exit in `exits.txt`. The folder keeps its comms-era name `T153-macm3/`, as this issue's acceptance names it, not `I3-macm3/`.
- Nothing failed. Memory was tight in the last order: about 18 GB of 24 held by the nine processes, and swap rose from 1270 MB (read at 16:04 and 18:28 UTC) to a peak read of 4940 MB at 20:36. It is 1805 MB now.
